core:nutrition_loss.source: play value of the specification below the proposal of C1 (2 to 3 cm for 0.7): Portrait F et al. (2017), Econ Hum Biol 27:339-348; Goergens T, Meng X, Vaithianathan R (2012), J Dev Econ 97:99-111 (1 to 2 cm after correcting for selective survival)

core:nutrition_weight_infant.source: play value of the specification: the first two years of life are the most sensitive window (Portrait 2017; Kesternich I et al. (2014), Rev Econ Stat 96:103-118)
core:nutrition_weight_infant.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, weight of the window below core:nutrition_age_infant (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_weight_child.source: play value of the specification for early childhood after the first two years
core:nutrition_weight_child.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, weight of the window from core:nutrition_age_infant to core:nutrition_age_child (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_weight_puberty.source: play value of the specification for the pubertal growth spurt
core:nutrition_weight_puberty.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, weight of the window around theta_i, not below core:nutrition_age_child (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_age_infant.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, end of the first window in years of age (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_age_child.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, end of the second window in years of age (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_puberty_before.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, the puberty window starts this many years before theta_i (ADR-0013)

core:nutrition_puberty_after.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.4, the puberty window ends this many years after theta_i (ADR-0013)

core:puberty_half_width.source: play value decided by Grok 4.7 on 2026-10-08 (ADR-0011): the sex differences of 6.2 rise over four years around theta_i
core:puberty_half_width.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 6.2 (K6.2a); half width of the smoothstep of the puberty progress P (ADR-0014)

core:height_loss_onset.source: Sorkin JD, Muller DC, Andres R (1999), Am J Epidemiol 150:969-977 (Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging): height loss begins at about 30 years
core:height_loss_onset.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.3 (K5.3c); bio_age from which height is lost (ADR-0014)

core:height_loss_male.source: play curve decided by Grok 4.7 on 2026-10-08 through Sorkin JD, Muller DC, Andres R (1999), Am J Epidemiol 150:969-977: about 3 cm lost from 30 to 70 in men
core:height_loss_male.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.3 (K5.3a); 3/1600, so 3 cm at bio_age 70 and 4.69 cm at 80 (ADR-0014)

core:height_loss_female.source: play curve decided by Grok 4.7 on 2026-10-08 through Sorkin JD, Muller DC, Andres R (1999), Am J Epidemiol 150:969-977: about 5 cm lost from 30 to 70 in women
core:height_loss_female.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 5.3 (K5.3b); 5/1600, so 5 cm at bio_age 70 and 7.81 cm at 80 (ADR-0014)
